headline: Sensex and Nifty under pressure as crude oil hits $107; HCLTech and Natco Pharma in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices surged to $107 per barrel due to supply fears and a stalemate in the US-Iran deal.
Weak global cues as US markets fell on the back of higher Treasury yields and rising energy costs.
Bearish sentiment following a major crash on September 28 that wiped out Rs 7.4 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Technical weakness as ten significant stocks crossed below their 200-day moving averages.
whatHappening: HCLTech is expanding its international footprint by acquiring Croatia-based Robotiq.ai for 9 million euros.
Natco Pharma has increased its strategic investment in US-based biotech firm eGenesis to $16.7 million.
The US government has exempted India from 100% tariffs on speciality drugs, providing a boost to the pharma sector.
Multiple IPOs are in focus today, including allotment status for Moneyview and A-One Steels, and listings for Himalaya Nutravedics.
summary: The Indian market faces significant headwinds as crude oil prices climb toward $107, following a massive sell-off that saw the Sensex plunge over 1,100 points. While global cues remain weak, the pharma sector received a boost from US tariff exemptions and Natco Pharma's increased international investment. Investors are also monitoring HCLTech's latest acquisition and several IPO allotments and listings scheduled for today.
